items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: it made John Cage sound like cocktail music

ctx.x: You had stated way back in ’76 that you liked Chinese and Japanese music, there’s so much space in it.

Yeah, oh yeah, very much. I love it. I don’t listen to it so much now but I remember there was one time when I went to Japan, I went to, I don’t know if you’re familiar with the Noh Theater, where they wear the masks, and I think all the parts are played by men even if it’s a woman, but they’ve got all these weird masks. And off to the side would be three guys. One was a singer, one played a string and one played a wood block or percussion. And the music was so far out. I mean it made John Cage sound like…
I think they call it an erhu or something like that.
